puzzle.hint: A famous prophetic du'a from Ibrahim (Abraham) seeking forgiveness for himself, his parents, and all believers on the Day of Judgment.
puzzle.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
puzzle.verseEn: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the believers the Day the account is established."
